prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Examination revealed localized tenderness and swelling over the distal radius of the affected wrist, with reduced grip strength on the injured side. Imaging was consistent with a wrist fracture. Neurovascular status of the hand was intact, and the remaining orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. The patient has no known prior injury to this wrist or the surrounding area. Over three visits, the patient was treated with immobilization, pain management, and a graduated home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course, and symptoms steadily improved, so care was tapered off at the final visit. At this time, it remains unclear whether the fracture is entirely attributable to this incident, and the billing records for two similar charges on the same date of service are under review.
